notes.title: Chapter 3 Release
notes.notes:
Hello Rebels!

I'm proud to announce that Chapter 3 has been launched yesterday.
If you haven't checked it out yet, feel free to do so:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2177640/Rebels__Under_the_Spell_of_Magic_Chapter_3/]Here's the Link[/url]

Thank you all for your support!
